newsitem.title: USA: Spieker files $1.0 bln shelf debt, equity.
newsitem.headline: Spieker files $1.0 bln shelf debt, equity.

text.p: Spieker Properties Inc said on Friday it filed a shelf registration with the Securities and Exchange Commission for up to $1.0 billion in common and preferred stock and debt securities.
Spieker said the debt securities would be offered by its operating partnership, Spieker Properties L.P.
When combined with previuous registrations, the company said it would have up to $1.457 billion worth of those securities, including depositary shares and warrants, available for sale.
It said net proceeds from the equities offering will be invested in the operating partnership.
The partnership will in turn use funds received from the parent and net proceeds from its debt securities offering for general corporate purposes.
